answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 1398 Country: India Title: Is trading with shares of software companies is allowed in Islam? Question: Is trading with shares of software companies is allowed in Islam? Answer ID: 1398 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 290/590=N) Share trading of software companies is allowed provided they invent the software and do not pirate the software of others. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
